title: Multimodal genotype-phenotype analysis in SMARCB1-associated developmental disorders.
authors: Saad, Ramy; Cobolli Gigli, Clementina; van der Sluijs, Pleuntje J; Wilson, Jon R; Hsieh, Tzung-Chien; McConnell, Vivienne P M; Bacino, Carlos A; Bird, Lynne M; Adam, Shelin; Clarke, Lorne; Cobben, Jan M; Travessa, Andre M; Faivre, Laurence; Farholt, Stense; Gregersen, Pernille A; van Hasselt, Jos; Lahiri, Nayana; Palmer, Elizabeth E; Sheffer, Ruth; Clayton-Smith, Jill; Wilnai, Yael; Deshpande, Charu; Morton, Jenny E V; Clement, Emma; Santen, Gijs W E; Dias, Cristina
journal: Genetics in medicine : official journal of the American College of Medical Genetics
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习与三维蛋白建模分析SMARCB1变异与表型关联，虽涉及蛋白结构预测但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Variants in SMARCB1, encoding a core subunit of the BAF (ie, BRG/BRM-associated factor) chromatin remodeling complex, are associated with intellectual developmental disorders, particularly Coffin-Siris syndrome, although the genotype-phenotype spectrum remains incompletely defined. This study aims to assess the correlations between SMARCB1 variant location and phenotypic manifestations. METHODS: We analyzed 31 individuals with pathogenic or likely pathogenic SMARCB1 variants using multimodal approaches, integrating clinical, structural, and machine learning analyses. We predicted variant effects via 3-dimensional protein modeling, assessed facial similarity using GestaltMatcher, and conducted phenotype-driven genotype prediction using machine learning classifiers. RESULTS: Variants clustered within the N-terminal (winged-helix/SNF5) and C-terminal (alphaC-helix) regions. C-terminal Coffin-Siris syndrome variants were associated with more severe speech delay, microcephaly, and cleft palate, exhibiting stronger facial gestalt similarity. XGBoost achieved 96.7% accuracy in classifying variant location from phenotype alone. Although gestalt is a key feature delineating variants at the alphaC helix, overall clinical features have greater predictive power for N-terminal variants. CONCLUSION: Using detailed phenotyping and machine learning algorithms, we identified differences between individuals with N-terminus and C-terminus SMARCB1 variants. Our study underscored the importance of multimodal assessments for genotype-phenotype associations, suggesting that integrated modeling can provide insights into SMARCB1 variant effects and biological function, with the potential for improvement in diagnostic strategies.
abstract_zh: 目的：SMARCB1编码BAF（即BRG/BRM相关因子）染色质重塑复合物的核心亚基，其变异与智力发育障碍相关，尤其是Coffin-Siris综合征，尽管基因型-表型谱尚未完全明确。本研究旨在评估SMARCB1变异位置与表型表现之间的相关性。方法：我们采用多模态方法，整合临床、结构和机器学习分析，对31名携带致病性或可能致病性SMARCB1变异的个体进行了分析。我们通过三维蛋白质建模预测变异效应，使用GestaltMatcher评估面部相似性，并利用机器学习分类器进行表型驱动的基因型预测。结果：变异聚集在N端（翼状螺旋/SNF5）和C端（alphaC-螺旋）区域。C端Coffin-Siris综合征变异与更严重的言语延迟、小头畸形和腭裂相关，并表现出更强的面部形态相似性。XGBoost在仅从表型分类变异位置方面达到了96.7%的准确率。尽管形态特征是区分alphaC螺旋变异的关键特征，但整体临床特征对N端变异具有更强的预测能力。结论：通过详细表型分析和机器学习算法，我们识别出N端和C端SMARCB1变异个体之间的差异。我们的研究强调了多模态评估在基因型-表型关联中的重要性，表明整合建模可以提供对SMARCB1变异效应和生物学功能的见解，并有可能改进诊断策略。
